integrity: All counts and orbit membership recomputed from the included standalone exhaustive checker; the finite domain is rigorously justified by vertex integrality and graph diameter.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite graph-specific orbit classification; no general formula for all Möbius ladders, full face vector, or independent scholarly originality audit. The general tight-edge criterion is prior work. Graph-level facet databases remain a possible overlap risk.
title: Thirteen symmetry classes of facets for the Wagner metric
